title.zh: Symbiosis says it recovered 15 BTC after Bitcoin bridge exploit, offers attacker 20% bounty
title.en: Symbiosis says it recovered 15 BTC after Bitcoin bridge exploit, offers attacker 20% bounty

current_state.zh: Symbiosis recovered 15 BTC after a Bitcoin bridge exploit in which roughly 46.1 billion syBTC were minted but the attacker realized only about $336,000, and the protocol is offering the attacker a 20% bounty.
current_state.en: Symbiosis recovered 15 BTC after a Bitcoin bridge exploit in which roughly 46.1 billion syBTC were minted but the attacker realized only about $336,000, and the protocol is offering the attacker a 20% bounty.
